Our Story

A little shop with a long memory, run by people who believe the right book at the right time can change everything.

From a single shelf to a neighborhood landmark

Inkwell & Quill opened its doors in the autumn of 1998 with one creaky shelf, a secondhand till, and a hand-lettered sign in the window. Our founder, Margaret Quill, had spent twenty years recommending books to friends and finally decided to make a vocation of it.

A quarter century later, those shelves now climb to the ceiling, the rolling ladder squeaks just so, and there is always a pot of coffee on in the back. We have stayed stubbornly independent because we believe a bookstore should be shaped by the people who run it and the readers who fill it — not an algorithm.

Every title in the shop has been chosen by a human who wanted it here. That is the whole philosophy, and it has never let us down.
